competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Apply basic first aid (medicinal-plants strand): itinutugma ng BHW ang bawat isa sa sampung halaman sa botanical name, nakalistang bahagi at nakalistang gamit sa kasalukuyang reference card, sinasabi kung ano pa ang kailangang kumpirmahin, at iniuugnay ang tanong ng residente sa clinician — nang hindi naghahanda, nagtatakda ng dose o nagpapalit ng niresetang gamot.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Apply basic first aid (medicinal-plants strand): the BHW matches each of the ten plants to its botanical name, listed part and listed use on a current reference card, states what still needs confirmation, and connects the resident's question to a clinician — without preparing a remedy, setting a dose or replacing prescribed treatment.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ihambing ang dalawang card at tukuyin ang kailangan pang kumpirmahin bago ang anumang paggamit.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Compare two cards and identify what needs confirmation before any use.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Pumipili ng halaman ayon sa pangalan, larawan o gamit ng pamilya, o nagbibigay ng dose.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Picks a plant by name, picture or family use, or gives a dose.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Namamarkahan ang botanical name, bahagi at dapat kumpirmahin sa dalawang card, at ang kokonsultahin, nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Marks the botanical name, part and what needs confirmation on both cards, and who to consult, without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naihahambing ang card ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa iisang pangalan o sa kokonsultahin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Compares the cards but needs a prompt on the shared name or on who to consult.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Pumipili ng halaman ayon sa pangalan, larawan o gamit ng pamilya, o nagbibigay ng dose.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Picks a plant by name, picture or family use, or gives a dose.

observation_indicators.observable_en: For Akapulko, match the botanical name, plant part and listed use. Explain the boundary and consultation need.

observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Calls the rash ringworm, treats the yard plant as Akapulko, or explains a preparation.

levels.kaya_na_en: Matches Senna alata, leaves and listed use, and names when Ana’s rash needs health-center assessment, without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naitutugma ang card ngunit kailangan ng paalala na hindi kumpirmado ang halaman o na dapat ipasuri ang pantal.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Matches the card but needs a prompt that the yard plant is unconfirmed or that the rash needs assessment.
